message: You know that one friend who panics at the slightest hint of danger? That's totally my buddy Sarah. The other day, we were cooking together and she spotted a pot bubbling over. Instead of just grabbing a towel, she jumped up, shouting about the fire alarms going off. We had a good laugh, but it reminded me how important it is to have a plan. We talked about smoke alarms and having an escape route, just in case. So, what's your go-to kitchen safety tip when things get a little too heated?
